summary: A FastAPI backend and a React single-page app in one repository, joined by a typed client generated from the API's OpenAPI document.
description: Puts a FastAPI service in backend/ and a React single-page app on Vite in frontend/, each complete with its own tests and commands. Orval generates the frontend's typed query hooks from the backend's OpenAPI document, the Vite dev server forwards /api to the API, and a root Makefile runs both parts' checks plus one that sends real requests from the frontend to the API. The base has no database or authentication; postgres adds persistence to the backend, while accounts remain your work.
seoDescription: A FastAPI backend and a React SPA on Vite in one repository, with an Orval client generated from OpenAPI and checks that run both parts together.
